title: BOHM: Zero-Cost Hierarchical Attribution for Compound AI Systems
summary: Compound AI systems route tasks through hierarchies of specialised components. Attribution is dominated by Shapley-based methods (SHAP), which decompose a coalition value function into per-component marginal contributions and require evaluation of the system on arbitrary component subsets. That requirement fails for third-party APIs, opaque endpoints, and agentic orchestrators that concentrate routing on a few tools, leaving most coalitions un-evaluable from the deployed orchestrator. We introduce BOHM, which extracts a hierarchical attribution tree directly from the routing weights such systems already maintain: leaf attribution is the path product of root-to-leaf routing weights; level-k attribution is the induced distribution over depth-k nodes. The method has zero marginal cost, requires no access to component internals, and provides multi-resolution attribution at every level simultaneously, which flat methods cannot offer at any evaluation budget. BOHM and SHAP answer different questions and converge when the deployed router routes near-optimally. On 18 LLMs in a 3-level hierarchy over 880 LiveCodeBench problems, BOHM yields Kendall tau=0.928; SHAP reaches tau=0.980 at 9,000x more coalition evaluations per seed. On a 5-driver, 7-benchmark agentic study (35 cells, complete coverage), drivers concentrate routing on a single tool (top-share median 0.65), and cell-level tau(BOHM,SHAP) is predicted by whether the driver's top pick is the empirically best tool (mean +0.22 vs ~+0.01). On a US Census hierarchy (475 leaves, 4 levels), BOHM recovers ground-truth rankings at every level (tau up to 0.722). BOHM satisfies efficiency, monotonicity, symmetry, and weak suppression but not Shapley's additivity. It is best understood as a complementary primitive: a multi-resolution decomposition computable wherever routing state exists, whose disagreement with Shapley is itself diagnostic.

AI.tldr: BOHM是一种从路由权重直接提取层次化归因树的方法，无需访问组件内部或进行联盟评估，零边际成本提供多分辨率归因，在多个实验中与SHAP高度一致但计算成本低数千倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Shapley的归因方法（如SHAP）需要评估系统在任意组件子集上的表现，这在第三方API、不透明端点和代理型编排器等场景中无法实现，因为这些系统只路由到少数工具，大部分组件组合无法从部署的编排器中评估。
AI.method: BOHM直接从复合AI系统维护的路由权重中提取层次化归因树：叶子归因是根到叶子路径权重的乘积；第k层归因是深度k节点上的诱导分布。该方法零边际成本，无需访问组件内部，同时提供每个层级的多分辨率归因。
AI.result: 在18个LLM的3层层次结构（880个LiveCodeBench问题）上，BOHM的Kendall tau=0.928，SHAP达到tau=0.980但需要9000倍的联盟评估。在5个驱动程序、7个基准的代理研究中，驱动程序将路由集中在单一工具上（top-share中位数0.65），BOHM与SHAP的一致性由驱动程序是否选择了经验上最佳工具预测。在美国人口普查层次结构（475个叶子，4层）上，BOHM在每个层级恢复地面真实排名（tau最高0.722）。
AI.conclusion: BOHM满足效率、单调性、对称性和弱抑制性，但不满足Shapley的可加性。它应被理解为一种互补原语：可在存在路由状态的任何地方计算的多分辨率分解，其与Shapley的差异本身具有诊断价值。

title: NeuroNL2LTL: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Natural Language Translation of Linear Temporal Logic
summary: Effectively translating between natural language (NL) and formal logics like Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) requires expertise that limits formal verification's reach in safety-critical development. Template-based approaches sacrifice expressiveness for reliability; neural methods achieve fluency but provide no correctness guarantees. We present NeuroNL2LTL, a neurosymbolic architecture unifying learned translation with formal verification. NeuroNL2LTL routes translation through an intermediate representation whose mapping to LTL is structure-preserving by construction. Generated specifications undergo satisfiability and non-triviality checking; a minimal-edit repair mechanism corrects near-miss outputs before they reach downstream tools. The central innovation is verifier-in-the-loop training: verification outcomes serve as reward signals for reinforcement learning, producing neural components that optimize directly for formal correctness. On 200,000+ requirements spanning aerospace, robotics, autonomous vehicles, and ten additional domains, NeuroNL2LTL achieves 28\% semantic equivalence with reference specifications while ensuring 86\% of outputs are verified satisfiable. The system also generates contextually grounded explanations from LTL, enabling domain experts to validate specifications without specialized training. This work demonstrates that formal verification can function as both training objective and runtime filter for neural specification systems, allowing us to build neural-based tools whose reliability derives from logical guarantees rather than statistical confidence.

AI.tldr: NeuroNL2LTL提出了一种神经符号架构，将自然语言翻译为线性时序逻辑(LTL)，通过中间表示保证结构保持，结合可满足性检查、最小编辑修复和基于验证结果的强化学习训练，在20万+需求上实现28%语义等价和86%可满足性验证。
AI.motivation: 自然语言到形式逻辑(LTL)的翻译需要专业知识，限制了形式验证在安全关键领域的应用。模板方法牺牲表达力换取可靠性，神经方法流畅但无正确性保证。
AI.method: 提出神经符号架构NeuroNL2LTL：1) 通过中间表示进行翻译，映射到LTL的结构保持；2) 生成规范经过可满足性和非平凡性检查；3) 最小编辑修复机制修正接近正确的输出；4) 验证器参与训练：验证结果作为强化学习奖励信号，优化神经组件的形式正确性。
AI.result: 在20万+条覆盖航空航天、机器人、自动驾驶等13个领域的需求上，语义等价率达28%，86%的输出通过可满足性验证。系统还能从LTL生成上下文相关的解释。
AI.conclusion: 形式验证可以作为神经规范系统的训练目标和运行时过滤器，使基于神经网络的工具获得逻辑保证而非仅依赖统计置信度。

title: RMA: an Agentic System for Research-Level Mathematical Problems
summary: We present $\textbf{Research Math Agents (RMA)}$, an agentic framework for automated reasoning on research-level mathematical problems. Unlike prior studies centered on competition mathematics or formal theorem proving, RMA targets research-level mathematical problems that require long-horizon reasoning, literature grounding, and iterative proof refinement. RMA decomposes research-level proof solving into specialized modules for problem analysis, literature search and understanding, fair comparison, knowledge-bank construction, and proof verification, all coordinated by initializer, proposer, and verifier agents through a shared structured memory. Within this unified framework, these agents operate in a multi-role, multi-round workflow, collaboratively generating, refining, and verifying candidate proofs through iterative feedback. We evaluate RMA on the First Proof benchmark, which consists of ten research-level problems contributed by expert mathematicians across diverse domains. Through comprehensive expert evaluation, RMA outperforms strong baselines on the First Proof benchmark, including GPT-5.2R and Aletheia, solving eight out of ten research problems and producing more logically sound and readable proofs. Our comprehensive ablation studies further show that performance gains arise from the interaction of structured reasoning modules, iterative refinement, and verifier-based feedback, rather than any single component. Our solutions and implementations will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Research Math Agents (RMA)的智能体框架，用于自动化解决研究级数学问题。该框架通过多模块分解、多角色协作和迭代精炼，在First Proof基准上解决了10个研究级问题中的8个，优于GPT-5.2R和Aletheia等强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要集中在竞赛数学或形式化定理证明上，缺乏针对需要长期推理、文献基础验证和迭代精炼的研究级数学问题的自动化解决方案。

AI.result: 在First Proof基准（10个研究级问题）上，RMA解决了8个问题，优于GPT-5.2R和Aletheia等基线，生成更逻辑合理和可读的证明。消融实验表明性能提升来自结构化推理模块、迭代精炼和验证器反馈的整体交互。
AI.conclusion: RMA框架有效解决了研究级数学问题的自动化推理挑战，通过多角色协作和迭代反馈机制显著提升了证明生成的质量和可读性。

title: SciAtlas: A Large-Scale Knowledge Graph for Automated Scientific Research
summary: The exponential growth of global academic output has confronted researchers and AI agents with an unprecedented ``information explosion,'' where fragmented and unstructured knowledge organization impedes deep interdisciplinary integration. Current academic retrieval tools predominantly rely on superficial keyword matching or vector-space semantic retrieval, which lack the topological reasoning capabilities required to navigate complex logical connections. Agentic deep-research-based frameworks are often prone to logical hallucinations and consuming high inference costs. To bridge this gap, in this report, we introduce SciAtlas, a large-scale, multi-disciplinary, heterogeneous academic resource knowledge graph designed as a panoramic scientific evolution network. By integrating over 43M papers from 26 disciplines, and a total of 157M entities and 3B triplets, SciAtlas provides a structured topological cognitive substrate that dismantles disciplinary barriers and furnishes AI agents with a global perspective. Furthermore, we develop a neuro-symbolic retrieval algorithm featuring tri-path collaborative recall and graph reranking, achieving a seamless transition from simple semantic matching to deterministic association discovery. We also present key application directions of SciAtlas, including literature review, automated research trend synthesis, idea positioning, and academic trajectory exploration, to demonstrate that SciAtlas can serve as an effective ``cognitive map'' to empower the full loop of automated scientific research while significantly reducing reasoning costs. We have released the interfaces for KG retrieval and various downstream tasks in our GitHub repo.

AI.tldr: SciAtlas是一个大规模多学科异构学术资源知识图谱，包含43M+论文、157M实体和3B三元组，通过神经符号检索算法实现从语义匹配到确定性关联发现的转变，为AI代理提供全景科学认知地图，降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 当前学术信息爆炸，现有检索工具仅依赖关键词匹配或向量语义检索，缺乏拓扑推理能力；基于深度研究的Agent框架容易产生逻辑幻觉且推理成本高昂，亟需一种结构化的知识组织方式来打破学科壁垒。

AI.result: SciAtlas覆盖26个学科领域的43M+论文，构建了157M实体和3B三元组的知识图谱，提供了知识图谱检索和下游任务的接口。
AI.conclusion: SciAtlas可作为有效的"认知地图"，赋能自动化科学研究的完整流程，同时显著降低推理成本，有望推动跨学科深度融合和学术知识的结构化组织。

title: Energy per Successful Goal: Goal-Level Energy Accounting for Agentic AI Systems
summary:
Current AI energy benchmarks measure consumption at the granularity of a single model invocation or training run. For classical single-turn workloads this unit remains coherent. For agentic systems - where a single user goal may trigger multi-step orchestration, tool calls, retries, and failure-recovery cycles - the invocation count is an implementation artifact rather than a task property, and inference-level normalization misrepresents the energy cost of goal completion. We present A-LEMS (Agentic LLM Energy Measurement System), a cross-layer measurement framework that redefines the unit of AI energy accounting from energy per inference to Energy per Successful Goal (EpG). EpG aggregates total workflow energy across all execution attempts, including failures and retries, normalized by successfully completed goals. A-LEMS formalizes energy attribution through a temporal boundary model, a five-layer observation pipeline mapping RAPL signals to workflow-level energy, and a reproducibility protocol binding every measurement to hardware and runtime configuration. Building on EpG, we define the Orchestration Overhead Index (OOI), isolating the energy cost of orchestration relative to linear execution under identical task criteria.
  Across five reasoning and three tool-augmented task families, agentic workflows consume 4.33x higher mean energy per successful goal than linear baselines (888.1 J vs 205.3 J). This overhead is driven by orchestration structure, not inference compute. For tool-augmented tasks, OOI inverts below 1.0x: agentic execution is cheaper than linear, confirming the metric captures orchestration structure rather than a fixed upward bias.
  These findings establish that energy-per-inference is insufficient for agentic AI. EpG and OOI provide the measurement foundation for accurate benchmarking, where orchestration structure is the primary determinant of energy cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-LEMS框架，将AI能源计量单位从每次推理能耗改为每成功目标能耗（EpG），并定义了编排开销指数（OOI）。实验表明，智能体系统能耗比线性基线高4.33倍，但工具增强任务中智能体执行反而更节能。
AI.motivation: 现有AI能源基准以单次推理或训练运行为粒度，这对单轮任务有效，但对智能体系统（多步编排、工具调用、重试、故障恢复）而言，调用次数是实现细节而非任务属性，推理级归一化错误地表示了任务完成的能源成本。
AI.method: 提出了A-LEMS（智能体LLM能耗测量系统），包含：1) 以每成功目标能耗（EpG）为计量单位；2) 时间边界模型用于能耗归属；3) 五层观测管线将RAPL信号映射到工作流级能耗；4) 可重复性协议绑定测量与硬件/运行时配置；5) 编排开销指数（OOI）量化编排相对于线性执行的能耗成本。
AI.result: 在5种推理和3种工具增强任务族中，智能体工作流每成功目标平均能耗比线性基线高4.33倍（888.1J vs 205.3J）。工具增强任务中OOI逆转为低于1.0x，智能体执行比线性更便宜，验证了该指标能捕获编排结构而非固定向上偏差。
AI.conclusion: 每次推理能耗不足以衡量智能体AI的能源消耗。EpG和OOI提供了准确的基准测试基础，其中编排结构是能源成本的主要决定因素。

A temporal boundary model for formalizing energy attribution in multi-step agentic workflows, enabling precise assignment of energy consumption to specific task goals.
A five-layer observation pipeline that maps RAPL (Running Average Power Limit) signals to workflow-level energy consumption, providing hardware-aware energy measurement for agentic systems.
A reproducibility protocol that binds every energy measurement to hardware configuration and runtime state, ensuring reproducible AI energy benchmarking.

title: ImProver 2: Iteratively Self-Improving LMs for Neurosymbolic Proof Optimization
summary: Formal mathematics libraries are rapidly expanding, creating a growing need to refactor verified proofs for maintainability and to improve training data quality for neural provers. However, scalable proof optimization is hindered by heterogeneous and heuristically specified objectives, scarce data, and high training and inference costs. To overcome these challenges, we introduce ImProver 2, a neurosymbolic framework for automated proof optimization in Lean 4. ImProver 2 combines a data-efficient expert-iteration pipeline with a scaffold that exposes formal structure alongside lightweight informal abstractions. We further introduce a suite of metrics capturing structural proof properties. Using ImProver 2, we train a 7B-parameter model that outperforms orders-of-magnitude larger models within the same model family, and is competitive with mid-tier frontier models across metrics. We additionally demonstrate that our neurosymbolic scaffold significantly improves performance across both small and frontier models. We show that with proper scaffolding and training, small models can effectively restructure research-level proofs over complex and varied metrics, matching substantially larger systems and establishing proof optimization as a scalable, learnable task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ImProver 2，一个用于Lean 4中自动证明优化的神经符号框架。通过数据高效专家迭代管道和暴露形式化结构及轻量级非形式化抽象的结构，训练出7B参数的模型，在多项指标上超越大几个数量级的模型，并与中端前沿模型竞争。

AI.result: 训练出的7B参数模型在同类模型中超越大几个数量级的模型，与中端前沿模型竞争。神经符号结构显著提升了小型和前沿模型的性能。小型模型在适当结构和训练下，能有效重构研究级证明，匹配更大的系统。
AI.conclusion: 证明了适当的结构化和训练可以使小型模型在复杂多样的指标上有效优化研究级证明，证明优化是一个可扩展、可学习的任务。

Method for training small language models (7B parameters) to restructure research-level proofs that outperform orders-of-magnitude larger models through proper scaffolding and training.

title: Mediative Fuzzy Logic: From Type-1 Foundations to Type-2, Type-3 and Quantum Extensions
summary: Mediative Fuzzy Logic was conceived as a practical scheme for reconciling hesitant or conflicting assessments in fuzzy control and decision-making. However, its logical and semantic foundations remain underdeveloped, especially beyond operational type-1 settings. This article develops a unified account of the type-1 core together with interval type-2, granular type-3, and quantum extensions. We characterize the mediative operator as a convex aggregation controlled by hesitation and contradiction, model mediative truth values as independent truth-falsity pairs in a continuous bilattice-like structure, and introduce a propositional system extending a standard t-norm-based fuzzy logic with a mediative connective. We establish soundness, paraconsistency, and conservativity over the underlying fuzzy base for formulas without mediation, and formulate coherent semantic extensions to interval type-2 truth values, granule-indexed local evaluations, and effects and density operators on Hilbert spaces. An autonomous-braking sensor-fusion example illustrates how the framework supports transparent, conservative, and safety-first decisions under incomplete, heterogeneous, and mildly contradictory evidence. Under suitable assumptions, the higher-level formulations reduce to the type-1 case, clarifying coherence across levels and reliably supporting future work in intelligent decision systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统发展了调解模糊逻辑(Mediative Fuzzy Logic)的类型-1核心及其区间类型-2、粒状类型-3和量子扩展，建立了统一的逻辑与语义基础，包括调解算子、调解真值模型、命题系统，并证明了可靠性、次一致性和保守性，最后通过自动驾驶刹车传感器融合示例验证了框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 调解模糊逻辑在模糊控制和决策中具有实用价值，但其逻辑和语义基础尚不完善，尤其是超越类型-1设置的理论基础匮乏，亟需建立统一的形式化框架。
AI.method: 将调解算子表征为由犹豫和矛盾控制的凸聚合；将调解真值建模为连续双格(bilattice)结构中的独立真-假对；引入基于t-norm模糊逻辑的调解连接词命题系统；构建区间类型-2、粒状类型-3及量子(希尔伯特空间效应与密度算子)扩展语义。
AI.result: 建立了调解模糊逻辑的可靠性、次一致性和对无调解公式的保守性；高阶扩展在适当假设下可归约为类型-1情形；通过自动驾驶刹车传感器融合示例展示了框架在证据不完整、异质和轻微矛盾情况下的透明、保守和安全优先决策能力。
AI.conclusion: 调解模糊逻辑的统一框架在不同层次间具有连贯性，能够可靠支持未来智能决策系统的研究和发展。

A propositional logic system extending t-norm based fuzzy logic with a dedicated mediative connective, featuring proven soundness, paraconsistency, and conservativity properties.
A continuous bilattice-like structure modeling mediative truth values as independent truth-falsity pairs for handling hesitation and contradiction simultaneously.

A transparent safety-first autonomous braking sensor fusion framework based on mediative fuzzy logic for handling incomplete, heterogeneous, and mildly contradictory sensor evidence.
A hierarchical reduction framework ensuring higher-level mediative formulations (type-2, type-3, quantum) reduce to the type-1 case under suitable assumptions, guaranteeing cross-level coherence.

title: EVE-Agent: Evidence-Verifiable Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents should not train on examples they cannot justify. Data-free self-evolving search agents offer a scalable route to systems that generate their own questions, answer them, and improve from their own feedback without human annotations. Yet, without verifiable evidence, this loop can reward fluent but unsupported examples, turning the self-generated curriculum into an opaque and potentially unreliable training signal. We argue that evidence verifiability is a prerequisite for trustworthy self-evolution in search agents: each generated instance should include not only an answer but also a source-grounded span whose contribution to that answer can be measured. We introduce EVE-Agent, an Evidence-Verifiable Self-Evolving Agent that operationalizes this principle through a modification to the proposer--solver framework. The proposer generates a question, an answer, and a verbatim evidence span. An evidence verifier then rewards the span according to the marginal accuracy gain when the evidence is provided. This produces a training signal that favors evidence that genuinely helps answer the question, without requiring oracle answers, human labels, or external annotations. EVE-Agent leaves the backbone model, retriever, search tool, and optimization framework unchanged. Experiments show that EVE-Agent substantially improves evidence-grounded correctness over prior self-evolving search agents. The resulting curriculum is not merely self-generated but auditable by construction: each training example carries an inspectable source span that explains why it should be trusted.

AI.tldr: EVE-Agent提出了一种证据可验证的自我进化框架，通过生成器-求解器架构和证据验证器，确保自生成训练样本包含可核查的源文本片段，从而解决自我进化智能体中不可靠训练信号的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有自我进化智能体在无人类标注的闭环中可能奖励流畅但无证据支持的样本，导致训练信号不可靠。作者认为证据可验证性是自我进化搜索智能体可信赖的前提条件。
AI.method: 修改提议者-求解者框架：提议者生成问题、答案和逐字证据片段；证据验证器根据提供证据时的边际准确率增益对片段进行奖励，产生偏好训练信号，无需人工标注。
AI.result: EVE-Agent在基于证据的正确性上显著优于先前的自我进化搜索智能体，每个训练样本都带有可核查的源文本片段。
AI.conclusion: 自我进化智能体的训练课程不仅应自动生成，还应天生可审计，每个训练样本携带可检查的源文本片段，解释其为何值得信任。

Proposer-solver framework modification with integrated evidence verifier that computes preference signals from evidence contribution

title: The Deterministic Horizon: Impossibility Results as Design Specifications for Trustworthy AI Systems
comment: PhD thesis, Department of Computer Science, The University of Hong Kong, 2026. 271 pages, 18 figures, 15 tables, 5 algorithms
summary: Large language models now write software, draft legal documents, and produce clinical notes, yet fundamental limits, from Turing and Arrow to the No Free Lunch theorems, shape what computation can do. This thesis turns such impossibility results from curiosities into design rules. Its flagship result proves an accuracy ceiling set by architecture alone: past a critical reasoning depth, no amount of training moves it, at any adapter rank, sample size, or loss function. Computable before deployment from layer count and embedding width, this Deterministic Horizon is measured between nineteen and thirty-one across twelve transformer architectures, and fine-tuning on optimal-length traces recovers under four percentage points. The mechanism is a capacity invariant of the residual stream, and an information-theoretic conversion yields super-exponential accuracy decay past the horizon. An unconditional circuit-complexity lower bound for modular exponentiation against constant-depth prime-modulus circuits complements this result. The same argument recasts across subfields: preference learning under any misspecified model jumps discontinuously in sample complexity; multi-stage retrieval pipelines require at least as many independent metrics as stages; standard truthful auctions fail for agents with prompt-dependent valuations; and zero-knowledge verification of neural inference pays a measured overhead of one hundred ten to one hundred ninety times per non-linear activation. Together these form a catalogue of sixteen specifications, each pairing a computable boundary, a quantified violation cost, and a constructive design rule: two compositions are proved, one pairing is an honest obstruction, and four remain open. The impossibility-specification methodology is offered for the generative research programme that trustworthy AI may need. Every fundamental limit of AI is also a design rule.

AI.tldr: 该论文将AI中的不可行性定理转化为设计规则，核心发现是：对于Transformer架构，存在由层数和嵌入宽度决定的"确定性视界"（Deterministic Horizon），在此深度后无论多少训练都无法提升准确率，并给出了跨领域的16个技术规范。
AI.motivation: 人工智能系统（如大语言模型）存在根本性的计算极限（图灵机、阿罗定理、没有免费午餐定理等），但这些理论通常被视为抽象的"好奇心"而非实用工具。论文旨在将这些不可能性结果转化为可操作的设计规则，为可信AI提供工程指导。
AI.method: 1. 理论推导：证明确定性视界（Deterministic Horizon）的存在——由架构层数和嵌入宽度决定的准确率上限，在训练前即可计算。2. 信息论转换：将残差流的容量不变量转化为超指数准确率衰减模型。3. 跨领域重述：将同一论证框架应用于偏好学习、多阶段检索、拍卖机制、零知识验证等不同子领域。4. 构建16个技术规范，每个规范包含可计算边界、量化违规成本、建设性设计规则。
AI.result: 1. 在12种Transformer架构上实测，确定性视界在19到31层之间，在最优长度轨迹上微调可恢复不到4个百分点的准确率。2. 模幂运算的无条件电路复杂度下界。3. 偏好学习在错误指定模型下样本复杂度存在不连续跳跃。4. 多阶段检索管道需要至少与阶段数一样多的独立指标。5. 标准诚实拍卖对提示依赖型估值无效。6. 零知识推理验证的开销为每个非线性激活110-190倍。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了"不可能性-规范"方法论（impossibility-specification methodology），证明每个AI的根本极限同时也是设计规则。给出了16个技术规范，其中2个组合已被证明，1个配对是诚实的障碍，4个仍为开放问题。该方法论为可信AI的生成式研究纲领提供了基础。

An information-theoretic conversion mechanism that translates residual stream capacity invariants into super-exponential accuracy decay models past a critical reasoning depth

title: PathCal: State-Aware Reflection-Marker Calibration for Efficient Reasoning
summary: The emergence of Large Reasoning Language Models (LRMs) has paved the way for tackling complex reasoning tasks through test-time scaling by generating long-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories during inference. Meanwhile, these trajectories often contain explicit reflection markers such as ``wait'', ``but'', and ``alternatively'', signaling hesitation, revision, and the consideration of alternative explorations, respectively. Recent studies on test-time control leverage such markers as lightweight handles for steering reasoning, typically treating them as a single coarse-grained category rather than distinguishing their distinct functional roles. In this paper, we conduct type-wise suppression and fixed-prefix intervention, revealing that reflection markers differ not only in their functional roles but also in when they exert the greatest influence. Specifically, different marker classes affect accuracy and generation length in distinct ways, and marker choices are most consequential before the model settles into a stable reasoning trajectory. Motivated by these findings, we introduce PathCal, a novel training-free decoding controller that calibrates reasoning paths by distinguishing marker types and intervening only at locally uncertain states. At each decoding step, PathCal utilizes the distribution over reflection-markers to estimate local competition between maintaining the current reasoning trajectory and initiating a competing branch, and softly rebalances marker logits when competing-branch evidence becomes excessive. Experiments across six reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PathCal achieves a better efficiency--performance trade-off, improving or preserving accuracy while reducing generation length, without relying on external verifiers or additional sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PathCal——一种无需训练的解码控制器，通过区分推理过程中的反思标记（如"wait"、"but"、"alternatively"）类型，并在局部不确定状态进行软干预，在保持或提升推理准确率的同时减少生成长度，实现效率与性能的更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的大推理模型（LRMs）在推理过程中会生成包含反思标记的长链思维轨迹，但大多数研究将这些标记视为单一粗粒度类别，忽略了它们不同的功能角色及其对推理行为的影响。作者通过实验发现不同类别的反思标记在影响准确率和生成长度上存在差异，且标记选择在模型进入稳定推理轨迹前影响最大，因此需要一种能区分标记类型并适时干预的解码控制方法。
AI.method: PathCal是一种训练-free的解码控制器，核心包括：(1) 区分反思标记类型（如犹豫、修订、替代探索等），每种类型具有不同的功能角色；(2) 在每步解码时，利用反思标记的分布估计当前推理轨迹与竞争分支之间的局部竞争程度；(3) 当竞争分支证据过度时，对标记logits进行软重新平衡，在不依赖外部验证器或额外采样的情况下校准推理路径。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准测试上，PathCal实现了更好的效率-性能权衡：在保持或提升准确率的同时减少了生成长度，且无需外部验证器或额外采样。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分反思标记的类型并仅在局部不确定状态下进行干预，可以有效控制LRMs的推理过程，在不牺牲准确率的前提下减少不必要的推理长度，为测试时可控推理提供了一种轻量级、无需训练的解决方案。

A technique for type-wise suppression and fixed-prefix intervention on reflection markers that reveals distinct functional roles and optimal timing of influence for different marker classes.

A decoding-time control framework that improves or preserves reasoning accuracy while reducing generation length by calibrating reasoning paths through marker-type differentiation and locally uncertain state intervention.

title: Inductive Deductive Synthesis: Enabling AI to Generate Formally Verified Systems
summary: AI agents increasingly excel at generating, testing, and refining code. However, they fall short on tasks requiring formal guarantees of full coverage that testing alone cannot provide. Distributed systems are a prime example: properties such as consistency between reads and writes must hold under every possible interleaving of events. Mechanized formal verification can guarantee such correctness, but typically demands months to years of expert effort. As evidence, even SOTA coding agents (Codex with GPT-5.4 and Claude Code with Opus 4.6) succeed on only 2/7 distributed key-value-store specifications. In this paper, we present the first effective approach to addressing this gap, Inductive Deductive Synthesis (IDS), which jointly and incrementally synthesizes implementation and proof, and learns from failed attempts to systematically try promising strategies. Built as an agentic LLM system, IDS achieves 7/7 in about 6.8 hours and $106 per spec on average, roughly 200x faster than expert effort and 17% cheaper than SOTA agents. IDS further incorporates performance feedback into the same loop, yielding implementations up to 3x faster than published verified systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出归纳演绎综合（IDS）方法，通过联合增量地综合实现与证明，并从失败尝试中学习，使AI智能体能够自动完成分布式系统的机械化形式验证，在键值存储规范上达到7/7的成功率，比专家快约200倍且比SOTA智能体便宜17%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体在代码生成、测试和优化方面表现出色，但无法完成需要形式化全覆盖保证的任务（如分布式系统验证）。机械化形式验证虽能保证正确性，但通常需要专家数月到数年的努力，而当前最先进的编码智能体在分布式键值存储规范上的成功率仅为2/7。
AI.method: 提出归纳演绎综合（IDS）方法：联合且增量地综合实现与形式化证明，从失败尝试中学习以系统性地探索有前景的策略。该方法构建为一个智能体LLM系统，将性能反馈纳入同一循环中。
AI.result: IDS在7个分布式键值存储规范上达到7/7的成功率，平均每个规范耗时约6.8小时、成本约106美元，比专家快约200倍，比SOTA智能体便宜17%。生成的实现比已发布的经过验证的系统快3倍。
AI.conclusion: IDS证明了通过结合归纳推理与演绎验证、利用失败经验学习，可以大幅降低分布式系统形式验证的门槛，同时提升实现性能，为自动化软件正确性保证开辟了新路径。
idea_en: Inductive Deductive Synthesis (IDS): A method that jointly and incrementally synthesizes both implementation code and formal proof, enabling automated formal verification of distributed systems.
Failure-driven learning mechanism for formal verification: An agentic LLM system that systematically learns from failed verification attempts to explore more promising synthesis strategies.

title: Redrawing the AI Map: A Theory of Accountability Boundaries in Agentic Ecosystems
summary: Agentic AI orchestrators reduce the interface and assembly costs of composing information systems capabilities across organizational boundaries, seemingly accelerating modularization and organizational disaggregation. Yet AI-enabled capabilities whose outputs require evidence, review, signoff, or assignable responsibility may retain integrated accountability boundaries even when their technical interfaces become modular. We develop a capability-level theory of accountability-boundary placement in agentic ecosystems. We introduce accountability assets: complementary assets that make AI-supported outputs legitimate, auditable, reviewable, and assignable to a responsible party. We argue that verification cost and responsibility transferability determine whether the execution and accountability boundaries can move together. The theory identifies three boundary strategies: component, integrated, and dual-track. It also introduces rule debt, the governance burden that accrues when organizational decision rules migrate from formal information systems into ungoverned agentic execution environments. Integrating digital innovation, transaction cost, complementary-assets, digital platform governance, and IS control perspectives, we develop seven propositions linking agentic assembly-cost reductions, accountability assets, appropriability, orchestrator intent capture, and boundary misconfiguration to boundary strategy, value appropriation, and rule debt. The theory explains when digital modularization extends to organizational disaggregation and when accountability keeps capabilities integrated. Structured illustrations across document processing, legal services, audit, clinical decision support, and procurement discipline the boundary logic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agentic AI生态系统中问责边界放置的能力级理论，引入"问责资产"和"规则债务"概念，分析了在AI编排器降低技术接口成本时，为何问责边界可能仍保持整合状态，并识别了三种边界策略。
AI.motivation: 解释为何AI编排器降低了模块化技术成本，但组织的问责边界（如需要证据、审查、签收和可分配责任的能力）可能仍然保持整合，即使技术接口已变得模块化。
AI.method: 结合数字创新、交易成本、互补资产、数字平台治理和IS控制等多重视角，发展能力级理论，提出七个命题，并通过文档处理、法律服务、审计、临床决策支持和采购等结构化示例进行论证。
AI.result: 识别出三种边界策略（组件式、整合式和双轨式），提出验证成本和责任可转移性决定执行边界与问责边界能否共同移动的核心论点，并引入"规则债务"概念描述治理负担。
AI.conclusion: 该理论解释了数字模块化何时扩展到组织分解，以及问责何时使能力保持整合，对AI代理生态系统的设计和治理提供了理论指导。

An accountability asset framework for AI-supported outputs that ensures legitimacy, auditability, reviewability, and assignable responsibility through complementary asset integration.
A method for detecting boundary misconfiguration in agentic AI systems where technical modularity diverges from accountability integration requirements, triggering reconfiguration alerts.

A dual-track execution architecture for agentic AI that separates technical execution boundaries from accountability boundaries, allowing parallel processing paths for verification and responsibility assignment.

title: AutoResearch AI: Towards AI-Powered Research Automation for Scientific Discovery
summary: Scientific research is being reshaped by AI systems that move beyond isolated assistance toward longer-horizon workflows spanning literature grounding, hypothesis generation, experimentation, validation, reporting, and revision. This shift marks a transition from task-level AI for science to workflow-level research automation. Yet current systems remain fragmented, differing in autonomy, domain scope, execution environment, validation mechanism, and human oversight, while still struggling with evidence preservation, reproducibility, weak-direction rejection, provenance tracking, cross-domain robustness, and accountable scientific closure. This survey examines these developments through AutoResearch, defined as the developmental spectrum of AI-powered scientific workflow automation. Within it, Vibe Research denotes the human-steered region of prompt-based assistance and human-verified execution, whereas emerging AI-led systems coordinate larger portions of the discovery loop without achieving robust autonomy. We analyze how research systems redistribute control, evidence, execution, validation, and accountability across workflows and organize the field around five workflow conditions: literature and research grounding; hypothesis formation and planning; experimentation and tool use; feedback, validation, and review; and reporting and knowledge communication. We further synthesize AI scientist systems, mixed-initiative co-research frameworks, benchmarks, domain deployments, and open-source infrastructures. Finally, we propose five evaluation dimensions--novelty, validity, impact, reliability, and provenance--and show that AutoResearch autonomy is domain-conditioned, being more credible in structured, executable, and rapidly verifiable settings but limited in embodied, delayed, heterogeneous, ethical, or institutionally accountable contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI驱动的科学工作流自动化（AutoResearch）的发展，从任务级AI向工作流级研究自动化转变，分析了现有系统在自主性、领域范围、验证机制等方面的碎片化问题，并提出了五个评估维度和未来发展方向。
AI.motivation: AI在科学研究中的应用正从孤立的任务辅助转向更长周期的工作流自动化，但现有系统在自主性、领域跨度、证据保留、可重复性等方面存在碎片化问题，缺乏系统性的分类和评估框架。
AI.method: 通过系统性综述，定义AutoResearch概念谱系，提出五个工作流条件（文献基础、假设生成、实验执行、验证反馈、报告传播）和五个评估维度（新颖性、有效性、影响力、可靠性、可溯源），并分类分析现有AI科学家系统、混合主动协同研究框架、基准测试、领域部署和开源基础设施。
AI.result: 识别出AutoResearch的自主性是领域条件化的，在结构化、可执行、可快速验证的场景中更可信，但在具身化、延迟反馈、异构、伦理或制度性问责的上下文中存在局限。现有系统在证据保存、可重复性、弱方向拒绝、溯源追踪、跨域鲁棒性和可问责的科学闭环等方面仍有挑战。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动的科学工作流自动化正在从Vibe Research（人类主导的提示式辅助）向AI主导的发现闭环演进，但完全自主的科学研究尚需解决跨域鲁棒性、证据溯源和制度性问责等关键问题。

title: Foundation Protocol: A Coordination Layer for Agentic Society
summary: Autonomous agents are moving from tools into a layer of social infrastructure: they browse, purchase, deploy software, manage systems, and increasingly interact with one another. As these systems scale, the bottleneck shifts away from raw model capability toward coordination. Agents need to form reliable relationships, organize multi-agent work, exchange value, support an AI economy, and stay safe and accountable under real-world oversight. This paper introduces the Foundation Protocol (FP), a graph-first coordination layer for an emerging human-AI society. FP unifies heterogeneous entities, including agents, tools, resources, humans, institutions, and organizations, and supports native multi-party organization and event-based collaboration. It also provides economic primitives for metering, receipts, and settlement, and treats policy, provenance, and audit as first-class concerns. FP is designed to wrap and bridge existing protocols rather than replace them, enabling incremental adoption while reducing integration and governance overhead. The aim is to keep autonomous agency composable while keeping accountability non-negotiable, so that coordination itself can become shared infrastructure for a human-AI society that is open, pluralistic, and governable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Foundation Protocol (FP)，一个面向人-AI社会的图优先协调层，用于统一管理代理、工具、资源、人类、机构等异构实体，支持多方组织、事件协作、经济原语及策略溯源审计，旨在实现可组合的自主代理与不可协商的问责制。
AI.motivation: 随着自主代理系统规模化，瓶颈从模型能力转向协调能力。现有协议缺乏统一框架来管理代理间关系、多智能体协作、价值交换、AI经济以及现实世界监督下的安全与问责。
AI.method: 提出Foundation Protocol (FP)：1) 图优先的协调层架构；2) 统一异构实体（代理、工具、资源、人类、机构等）；3) 原生多方组织和事件协作；4) 经济原语（计量、收据、结算）；5) 策略、溯源和审计作为一等公民；6) 包装桥接现有协议，支持渐进式采用。
AI.result: FP能够降低集成和治理开销，在保持自主代理可组合性的同时确保不可协商的问责制，为人-AI社会提供开放、多元、可治理的共享协调基础设施。
AI.conclusion: 协调本身可以成为人-AI社会的共享基础设施，FP通过图优先架构和经济原语，为开放、多元、可治理的人-AI社会提供了基础。

title: GENSTRAT: Toward a Science of Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: 33 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables (4 figures, 2 tables in main paper)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as economic agents in marketplaces, auctions, and bidding settings. Anticipating their behavior in any specific deployment is hard. Existing strategic-reasoning benchmarks evaluate models on fixed canonical games. These benchmarks may saturate as the frontier improves, and they do not allow evaluators to generalize with confidence from benchmark performance to the varied and messy strategic environments that actual deployments involve. We introduce GENSTRAT, which uses procedurally generated strategic environments to address these challenges. Concretely, we generate a distribution of two-player zero-sum imperfect-information card games. The generator can draw fresh games on demand, allowing for evergreen evaluation and resistance to contamination. We pair the game distribution with a capability-profile methodology that decomposes model competence across six axes (state space, temporal depth, information sensitivity, opponent modeling, risk, and brittleness). We also introduce a jaggedness measure of within-distribution smoothness that detects when a model's advantage jumps unpredictably between strategically similar games. We sample 50 benchmark games from a 2,000-game generated pool and evaluate nine frontier and open-weight LLMs in a head-to-head tournament with over 36,000 matches. Newer frontier-tier models score higher on average. Beyond that average, models with near-identical overall strength show qualitatively different capability profiles, and two of the top three leaderboard models (gpt-5 and claude) are noticeably more locally volatile than the third (gemini-3.1-pro), despite being close in overall strength. Together, the capability profile and the jaggedness measure give a deployment-relevant diagnostic that the overall ranking alone cannot provide.

AI.tldr: 提出GENSTRAT框架，通过程序化生成零和双人不完全信息纸牌游戏分布，结合多维能力画像和波动性度量，对LLM在战略环境中的表现进行全面评估。
AI.motivation: 现有战略推理基准采用固定规范博弈，存在饱和、污染问题，且无法从基准表现推广到实际部署中多样化的战略环境。
AI.method: 1) 构建可程序化生成的双人零和/不完全信息纸牌游戏分布；2) 设计六维能力画像（状态空间、时间深度、信息灵敏度、对手建模、风险、脆弱性）；3) 提出"锯齿度"指标衡量模型在同分布内表现的不平滑性；4) 从2000游戏池中采样50个基准游戏，在9个模型间进行36000+场比赛。
AI.result: 新前沿模型平均得分更高；整体实力相近的模型显示出质不同的能力画像；前三模型中gpt-5和claude比gemini-3.1-pro局部波动性明显更大。
AI.conclusion: 能力画像和锯齿度指标提供了整体排名无法提供的部署相关诊断信息，对评估模型在真实战略环境中的可靠性有重要意义。
idea_en: A method for evaluating LLM strategic reasoning using procedurally generated game distributions to prevent benchmark contamination and saturation.
A multi-dimensional capability profiling system that decomposes model competence across six axes (state space, temporal depth, information sensitivity, opponent modeling, risk, and brittleness).
A jaggedness measurement metric that detects local volatility in model performance across strategically similar game instances within the same distribution.
A systematic head-to-head tournament framework with over 36,000 matches for comparing LLMs in two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games.
idea_ch: 一种使用程序化生成游戏分布来评估LLM战略推理能力的方法，可防止基准污染和性能饱和。

title: Design and Report Benchmarks for Knowledge Work
summary: The development of LLM agents has led to a growing body of work on knowledge-work AI, including coding, research, and healthcare. However, current knowledge-work evaluation and benchmark design still largely follow the logic of traditional NLP tasks. As a result, higher benchmark performance does not reliably show that a system can carry out knowledge work in real-world deployment settings. This paper contributes a three-step approach for making explicit how benchmarked tasks represent the work claims attached to their scores: defining the work activity under evaluation, specifying the tested setting, and scoring the appropriate work product. We review work studies showing that knowledge work is organized through roles and responsibilities, local materials and tools, and artifacts that must remain usable in downstream workflows. We then translate these concerns into benchmark design and reporting guidance, covering how tasks should be mapped to work activities, how tested settings should specify materials, tools, roles, and constraints, and how scoring should focus on the work product left by the system. To name the work activity being evaluated and distinguish it from common benchmark tasks, we derive an inventory of 18 work activities from the O{*}NET occupational task database. We demonstrate the approach through three benchmark case analyses: GDPval, a non-code occupational deliverable benchmark; OfficeQA Pro, a grounded document-analysis benchmark scored by final answers; and APEX-SWE, a software-engineering benchmark with executable scored products. These cases show how benchmark design choices shape the strongest work claim a score can support, and where gaps arise between the benchmarked task, tested setting, scored product, and broader work claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种三步法，用于明确基准测试任务如何支撑其分数所附带的工作声明，涵盖定义工作活动、指定测试环境和评分适当工作产品。通过分析O*NET的18种工作活动，并展示三个基准案例分析（GDPval、OfficeQA Pro、APEX-SWE），揭示了基准设计选择与真实工作能力之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体的知识工作评估和基准设计仍遵循传统NLP任务逻辑，导致高基准性能并不能可靠反映系统在真实部署环境中执行知识工作的能力。需要一种方法使基准测试任务与其声称代表的工作能力之间的关联变得明确。
AI.method: 提出三步法：1）定义被评估的工作活动；2）指定测试环境（材料、工具、角色、约束）；3）对适当的工作产品进行评分。基于O*NET职业任务数据库推导出18种工作活动清单，并通过三个基准案例（GDPval、OfficeQA Pro、APEX-SWE）进行演示分析。
AI.result: 1）建立了工作活动清单（18种）；2）展示了基准设计选择如何塑造分数所能支持的最强工作声明；3）揭示了基准测试任务、测试环境、评分产品与更广泛工作声明之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 知识工作评估应关注角色与责任、本地材料与工具、以及在下游工作流中保持可用性的工件。基准设计应映射工作活动、明确指定测试环境，并以系统留下的工作产品为评分焦点。
idea_en: A three-step benchmark design method for LLM agent evaluation that explicitly maps benchmarked tasks to real-world work activities, including defining the work activity, specifying the tested setting (materials, tools, roles, constraints), and scoring the appropriate work product.
An inventory of 18 knowledge work activities derived from the O*NET occupational task database, specifically designed to name and distinguish work activities being evaluated in LLM agent benchmarks.

A benchmark evaluation framework that scores the work product left by the system (artifacts usable in downstream workflows) rather than intermediate NLP metrics, ensuring alignment with real-world deployment.
A case analysis methodology (applied to GDPval, OfficeQA Pro, APEX-SWE) for identifying gaps between benchmarked tasks, tested settings, scored products, and broader work claims.

从O*NET职业任务数据库推导出的18种知识工作活动清单，专门用于命名和区分LLM智能体基准中评估的工作活动。

title: Parallel Context Compaction for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Serving
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate growing conversation histories that eventually exceed the model's context window. Context compaction via LLM-based summarization keeps the conversation bounded, but summarization is inherently lossy and the blocking call stalls agent inference for tens of seconds. Moreover, the operator has no fine-grained control over summary volume since prompt instructions are largely ignored, and as context grows, both the amount of output tokens the model produces and the information it retains fluctuate substantially from run to run, making the agent's retained knowledge unpredictable across runs. We introduce \textbf{parallel compaction} for long-horizon agentic flows and characterize it against the sequential synchronous baseline across four backbones spanning 8B to 120B parameters, mixing dense and MoE architectures with reasoning and non-reasoning models, on the HotpotQA multi-hop QA and LoCoMo long-context dialogue benchmarks. Parallel compaction gives the operator fine-grained, predictable control over summary volume and enables more targeted prompt engineering per block. At matched compaction decode volume, it reduces end-to-end wall time and improves compaction throughput over the sequential baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并行压缩（parallel compaction）方法，用于长上下文LLM agent的对话历史管理，相比传统顺序压缩，能提供更精细的体积控制、更可预测的输出、更低的端到端延迟和更高的压缩吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM agent的对话历史不断增长，最终超过模型上下文窗口。现有基于LLM摘要的上下文压缩方法存在三个问题：1）压缩是有损的；2）阻塞式调用导致推理延迟数十秒；3）操作者无法精细控制摘要体积，prompt指令常被忽略，输出token数和信息保留量在不同运行间波动大，导致agent保留的知识不可预测。
AI.method: 提出并行压缩（parallel compaction）方法，用于长程agent流程。在HotpotQA多跳QA和LoCoMo长上下文对话基准上，使用四种不同规模（8B-120B参数）和架构（密集/MoE、推理/非推理模型）的骨干模型，将并行压缩与传统的顺序同步基线进行对比。
AI.result: 并行压缩为操作者提供了对摘要体积的细粒度、可预测控制，并支持按块进行更有针对性的prompt工程。在匹配压缩解码体积的条件下，并行压缩相比顺序基线减少了端到端墙钟时间，提高了压缩吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 并行压缩是一种更高效、可控的长上下文agent对话历史管理方法，能解决传统顺序压缩的延迟高、控制粒度粗、输出不可预测等核心痛点。
idea_en: A parallel compaction method for long-horizon agentic flows that processes multiple conversation history blocks simultaneously via LLM-based summarization, reducing end-to-end wall time and improving compaction throughput compared to sequential compaction.

A fine-grained volume control mechanism for LLM-based context compaction that enables predictable summary size per block through targeted prompt engineering, overcoming the limitation of prompt instruction being largely ignored in sequential approaches.

A block-level parallel summarization architecture for long-context dialogue management, where each block is independently summarized with customized prompts, enabling operator-specified compression ratios per segment.
A latency-reduced context compaction method that eliminates blocking calls in agent inference by parallelizing the summarization of multiple conversation history segments.
idea_ch: 一种用于长程agent流程的并行压缩方法，通过LLM摘要同时处理多个对话历史块，相比顺序压缩减少了端到端墙钟时间并提高了压缩吞吐量。

一种长上下文对话管理的块级并行摘要架构，其中每个块使用定制prompt独立摘要，使操作者能够指定每个段落的压缩比率。
一种降低延迟的上下文压缩方法，通过并行化多个对话历史段的摘要过程，消除了agent推理中的阻塞调用。

title: Ontological Knowledge Blocks: Executable Compliance and Profile-Based Validation for Trustworthy AI Systems
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the Security, Trust and Privacy for Software and Applications (STPSA) Workshop, IEEE COMPSAC 2026, Madrid, Spain, July 7-10, 2026
summary: AI-enabled services deployed in critical digital infrastructure are subject to governance obligations spanning transparency, accountability, fairness, and traceability. Compliance today remains documentation-centric: obligations are described in prose, audits rely on static checklists, and verification depends on manual review. Such approaches do not scale to automated AI systems. This paper introduces Ontological Knowledge Blocks (OKBs), a programmable governance infrastructure that compiles regulatory obligations into machine-checkable constraints over structured evidence graphs. We formalize an OKB as a 5-tuple that binds normative obligations to an RDF/OWL concept schema, executable SHACL validation rules, explicit evidence requirements, and PROV-O provenance links. A deterministic regulatory compiler translates structured Intermediate Representation (IR) records into composable KB modules, enabling profile-based governance reconfiguration without modifying service code. We implement two prototypes and evaluate them in an AI-assisted HPC resource allocation scenario across 24 validation runs and four governance profiles. Results demonstrate profile-sensitive validation, strictly additive violation accumulation, SHACL validation latency between 12.6 ms and 100.3 ms, and profile equivalence testing confirming Combined as the strictly most comprehensive profile. All artefacts are released as open source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ontological Knowledge Blocks (OKBs)，一种将监管义务编译为机器可检查约束的可编程治理基础设施，在AI辅助HPC资源分配场景中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理合规依赖文档、静态清单和人工审查，无法扩展到自动化AI系统，亟需可编程的治理基础设施。
AI.method: 将OKB定义为5元组（规范义务+RDF/OWL概念模式+SHACL验证规则+证据要求+PROV-O溯源链接），通过监管编译器将中间表示(IR)记录编译为可组合的知识图谱模块。
AI.result: 在24次验证运行和4个治理配置文件下，SHACL验证延迟12.6ms-100.3ms，违规累加严格递增，配置文件等价性测试证实Combined为最全面配置。
AI.conclusion: OKB实现了从文档化治理到可编程、可验证的自动化治理的转变，可支持配置文件级治理重配置而无需修改服务代码。
idea_en: A programmable governance infrastructure (OKB) that compiles regulatory obligations into machine-checkable constraints over structured evidence graphs using a 5-tuple formalization binding normative obligations to RDF/OWL schema, SHACL rules, evidence requirements, and PROV-O provenance.

A deterministic regulatory compiler that translates structured Intermediate Representation (IR) records into composable Knowledge Base (KB) modules, enabling profile-based governance reconfiguration without modifying service code.
A method for strict additive violation accumulation across multiple governance profiles, enabling systematic compliance verification for AI systems in critical digital infrastructure.
Profile equivalence testing methodology that mathematically verifies one governance profile as strictly more comprehensive than others (e.g., Combined profile as superset).

title: DART: Semantic Recoverability for Structured Tool Agents
summary: When a structured tool agent fails mid-execution, the runtime faces a dilemma: replaying the entire task is safe but wasteful, while restoring from a local checkpoint is efficient but can leave committed downstream work tied to an upstream history that no longer exists. This tension is acute in commitment-sensitive settings, where rollback targets a single failed instance yet downstream consumers have already acted on its output. Existing recovery approaches provide mechanical rollback but no criterion for whether a local restore remains semantically valid after downstream commitment. We formalize this gap as semantic recoverability and address it in DART, a modular runtime that localizes the failed instance, certifies semantically recoverable boundaries of that instance, aligns checkpoints to those boundaries, and selects an admissible restore point that preserves committed downstream work under dependency and effect constraints-or blocks otherwise. Across three LLM-driven domains and external validation on a LangGraph-based substrate, DART correctly recovers all evaluated commitment-sensitive cases where baseline local recovery fails, and a five-domain safety audit finds no unsafe admitted rollbacks. These results show that controller legality does not imply semantic validity, and that sound local recovery requires an explicit admissibility check.

AI.tldr: DART是一种模块化运行时系统，通过语义可恢复性检查来解决结构化工具代理在失败时的恢复问题，确保在存在下游依赖提交的情况下仍能安全高效地恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有恢复方法提供机械回滚，但缺乏判断局部恢复在下游提交后是否语义有效的标准，导致承诺敏感场景下恢复失败或产生安全隐患。
AI.method: DART通过定位失败实例、认证其语义可恢复边界、将检查点对齐到这些边界、选择满足依赖和效应约束的可接受恢复点来解决问题。
AI.result: 在三个LLM驱动领域和基于LangGraph的外部验证中，DART正确恢复了所有基线局部恢复失败的承诺敏感案例，五领域安全审计未发现不安全的恢复。
AI.conclusion: 控制器合法性不等同于语义有效性，可靠的局部恢复需要显式的可接受性检查。
idea_en: Semantic recoverability certification mechanism for determining whether a local restore point remains semantically valid after downstream commitments have been made.
Boundary-aligned checkpointing system that aligns checkpoints to semantically recoverable boundaries of a failed instance.
Admissibility check module that selects restore points preserving committed downstream work under dependency and effect constraints.
DART modular runtime architecture for localized failure recovery in structured tool agents with commitment-sensitive recovery.
Effect-aware rollback decision system that blocks recovery when it cannot preserve committed downstream work.
idea_ch: 一种语义可恢复性认证机制，用于判断在下游提交后局部恢复点是否仍然语义有效。
边界对齐检查点系统，将检查点对齐到失败实例的语义可恢复边界。
可接受性检查模块，在依赖和效应约束下选择保留已提交下游工作的恢复点。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Ventilator Decision Support with Contextual Bandit Preference Learning
summary: Ventilator decision support requires sequential decisions that track evolving physiology and disease trajectories while respecting safety boundaries and clinician specific tuning styles. Rule based approaches rarely generalize personalization, and end to end reinforcement learning or single large language model systems remain difficult to control and audit. We propose the Ventilator Decision Support System (VDSS), a human in the loop multi agent framework that coordinates modular decision components through contract driven structured interfaces and produces traceable evidence for review. VDSS performs online preference adaptation with a contextual bandit, updating clinician specific preferences from the final accepted decision at each adjustment cycle and using them to guide subsequent recommendations. Structured rejection feedback triggers targeted replanning to reduce unproductive iterations and improve interaction stability. Retrospective ICU trajectory replay with expert review indicates higher recommendation acceptability and fewer interaction rounds to reach an acceptable plan, supporting clinically deployable human AI collaboration.

AI.tldr: 提出VDSS，一种人机协同的多智能体呼吸机决策支持系统，通过合同驱动的结构化接口协调模块化决策组件，实现在线偏好自适应与结构化拒绝反馈，提升推荐可接受性与交互效率。
AI.motivation: 现有呼吸机决策支持系统存在通用性差、难以个性化、难以审计控制等问题，基于规则的方法无法泛化个性化，端到端强化学习或大语言模型难以控制和追溯。
AI.method: VDSS采用人机协同的多智能体框架，通过合同驱动的结构化接口协调模块化决策组件；使用上下文赌博机进行在线偏好自适应，从每次调整周期最终被接受的决策中学习临床医生特定偏好；结构化拒绝反馈触发针对性重新规划，减少无效迭代。
AI.result: 回顾性ICU轨迹回放与专家评审表明，VDSS具有更高的推荐可接受性，且达到可接受方案所需的交互轮次更少。
AI.conclusion: VDSS支持临床可部署的人机协作，通过模块化、可追溯、自适应偏好学习的方式提高了呼吸机决策支持的效率和可接受性。
idea_en: A human-in-the-loop multi-agent framework with contract-driven structured interfaces for ventilator decision support, enabling modular coordination and traceable evidence generation.
Online preference adaptation using a contextual bandit that learns clinician-specific preferences from accepted decisions in each adjustment cycle.
Structured rejection feedback mechanism that triggers targeted replanning to reduce unproductive iterations and improve interaction stability in clinical decision support.
idea_ch: 一种人机协同的多智能体呼吸机决策支持框架，通过合同驱动的结构化接口实现模块化协调与可追溯证据生成。
使用上下文赌博机进行在线偏好自适应的技术，从每次调整周期最终被接受的决策中学习临床医生特定的偏好。

title: When Planning Fails Despite Correct Execution: On Epistemic Calibration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems can fail even when planned actions are executed correctly because agents may misjudge their knowledge when evaluating plan feasibility, a phenomenon we term epistemic miscalibration in planning. Unlike execution errors, epistemic miscalibration is latent during planning, as generated plans can remain self-consistent and executable without observable errors; the miscalibration is also dynamic, as new information can alter feasibility assessments, potentially obscuring past miscalibration signals and causing them to recur over time. To address this, we propose the Epistemic Planning Calibration Agentic Workflow (EPC-AW), which assesses whether plans remain supported under varying information conditions rather than directly verifying feasibility. EPC-AW employs Information-consistency-based Plan Selection, selecting plans whose evaluations are stable across agents, together with Consistency-guided Epistemic State Refinement to adapt calibration over time by leveraging past discrepancies to guide future planning. Experiments show that EPC-AW improves system-level success by an average of 9.75%.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种解决多智能体系统中"认知校准偏差"问题的方法EPC-AW，通过信息一致性评估和认知状态细化来提升规划可靠性，平均系统成功率提升9.75%。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统在执行正确规划时仍可能失败，因为智能体会在评估计划可行性时误判自身知识，这种"认知校准偏差"是潜在且动态的，传统方法难以检测和解决。
AI.method: 提出了EPC-AW框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 基于信息一致性的计划选择，评估计划在不同信息条件下的稳定性；2) 一致性引导的认知状态细化，利用历史差异自适应调整校准。不同于直接验证可行性，而是评估计划在不同信息条件下是否仍然得到支持。
AI.result: 实验表明EPC-AW将系统级成功率平均提高了9.75%。
AI.conclusion: 通过信息一致性评估而非直接可行性验证，能有效解决多智能体规划中的认知校准偏差问题，提升系统可靠性。
idea_en: A system and method for detecting epistemic miscalibration in multi-agent planning by evaluating information-consistency of plans across varying information conditions rather than directly verifying plan feasibility.
An Information-consistency-based Plan Selection mechanism that selects plans whose feasibility evaluations remain stable across multiple agents under different information scenarios.
A Consistency-guided Epistemic State Refinement method that adaptively calibrates agent knowledge over time by leveraging past discrepancies to guide future planning decisions.
An Epistemic Planning Calibration Agentic Workflow (EPC-AW) framework that integrates information-consistency assessment with dynamic epistemic state refinement for multi-agent systems.
A method for identifying latent planning failures caused by knowledge misjudgment in LLM-based agents, where plans appear self-consistent and executable yet fail due to epistemic miscalibration.
idea_ch: 一种通过评估计划在不同信息条件下的信息一致性而非直接验证可行性来检测多智能体规划中认知校准偏差的系统与方法
一种基于信息一致性的计划选择机制，在不同信息场景下选择跨多个智能体保持稳定性评估的计划
一种一致性引导的认知状态细化方法，通过利用历史差异自适应校准智能体知识以指导未来规划决策
一种集成信息一致性评估与动态认知状态细化的认知规划校准智能工作流框架(EPC-AW)

title: EDGE-OPD: Internalizing Privileged Context with Evidence Guided On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has gained wide attraction as an LLM post-training paradigm due to its effectiveness in improving capabilities without introducing model distribution drift, and consequently, regression in general tasks. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) is an efficient use-case of OPD, which is appealing as it requires only a single model as a student and teacher, and it also has the benefit of providing privileged context that is a absent at inference time (e.g. a persona, a private fact, or a worked solution) to the teacher during the training process. The challenge in this approach is that the privileged information can change model behavior more than intended: it can modify reasoning, degrade general capabilities, and affect performance indicators like response length, style, or local token preferences. Consequently, OPSD may train the student on side effects rather than a desired, transferable behavior. In this paper, we study this problem in a rare-token/identity setting and propose EviDence GuidEd On-Policy Distillation (EDGE-OPD), a modification of OPSD with two distinct characteristics: a) it uses guided rollouts to inject privileged-context behavior to the student at sampling time, so that the rare target behavior is actually present in the on-policy data, and b) it applies an evidence mask: the student is updated only at token positions where the privileged context supports the sampled token, rather than on every token in the rollout. We empirically show that OPSD (and its variant RLSD, with and without a verifier) completely fail to learn a target identity, while the integration of guided rollouts allows them to succeed. Additionally, mask-region ablations show that the persona signal is localized to the positive-evidence tail, allows us to draw valuable insights about efficient knowledge transfer and preservation of general purpose capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EDGE-OPD方法，通过在采样时注入特权上下文并使用证据掩码，解决了On-Policy Self-Distillation中特权信息导致的行为漂移和副作用学习问题，成功实现稀有身份特征的有效迁移。
AI.motivation: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)虽然能利用推理时缺失的特权上下文（如身份、私密事实等）来训练模型，但特权信息会过度改变模型行为，导致推理能力退化、通用能力下降、响应长度/风格等指标异常。模型容易学习到副作用而非期望的可迁移行为。
AI.method: EDGE-OPD包含两个核心创新：a) 引导式rollout——在采样时向学生模型注入特权上下文行为，使稀有目标行为出现在on-policy数据中；b) 证据掩码——仅在与特权上下文支持采样token的位置更新学生模型，而非在rollout的每个token上更新。
AI.result: 实验表明，OPSD及其变体RLSD（无论有无验证器）完全无法学习目标身份，而集成引导式rollout后可以成功学习。掩码区域的消融实验显示，persona信号定位在正证据尾部，可实现高效知识迁移并保留通用能力。
AI.conclusion: EDGE-OPD通过引导式rollout和证据掩码机制，有效解决了OPSD中特权信息导致的副作用学习问题，实现了稀有身份行为的高效迁移，同时保持模型的通用能力不受影响。
idea_en: Evidence mask mechanism that selectively updates the student model only at token positions where privileged context supports the sampled token, preventing learning of irrelevant side effects.
Guided rollout technique that injects privileged-context behavior into the student model at sampling time, enabling rare target behaviors to appear in on-policy data for effective distillation.
EDGE-OPD framework combining guided rollouts and evidence masking for on-policy self-distillation, solving the problem of model distribution drift caused by privileged information.
Localized persona signal extraction method using positive-evidence tail analysis for efficient knowledge transfer while preserving general-purpose capabilities.
idea_ch: 证据掩码机制：仅在特权上下文支持采样token的位置更新学生模型，防止学习到无关的副作用行为
引导式rollout技术：在采样时向学生模型注入特权上下文行为，使稀有目标行为出现在on-policy数据中，解决数据稀疏问题
EDGE-OPD框架：结合引导式rollout和证据掩码的自蒸馏方法，有效解决特权信息导致的模型分布漂移
基于正证据尾部的persona信号定位方法：实现高效的知识迁移同时保留模型的通用能力

title: CP or DP? Why Not Both: A Case Study in the Partial Shop Scheduling Problem
summary: Dynamic Programming (DP) and Constraint Programming (CP) are well-established paradigms for solving combinatorial optimization problems. Usually, these two approaches are used separately. This paper aims to show that the two can be combined effectively and elegantly, with DP serving as the primary search framework and CP used as a subroutine to leverage global constraint propagation. This paper presents such an approach for the Partial Shop Scheduling Problem (PSSP), for which a pure DP method has previously been proposed, and efficient CP filtering algorithms are available. The PSSP is a general scheduling problem where each job consists of a set of operations with arbitrary precedence constraints. The approach is flexible enough to accommodate anytime DP strategies, such as anytime column search, whereas the original DP algorithm operated in a strictly layer-wise manner. Moreover, the flexibility of the CP modeling makes it straightforward to incorporate arbitrary precedence constraints. As a result, the model naturally handles any precedence graph and even enables the design of a Large Neighborhood Search (LNS) scheme, in which the DP model is reused, and partial-order schedules are imposed across restarts to improve the incumbent solution. While not competitive with state-of-the-art pure CP solvers for this specific problem, our primary contribution is demonstrating the viability of this hybrid integration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将动态规划（DP）作为主搜索框架、约束规划（CP）作为子程序利用全局约束传播的混合方法，用于解决部分车间调度问题（PSSP），并展示了这种混合集成的可行性。
AI.motivation: 动态规划和约束规划通常被分别用于求解组合优化问题，而本文旨在证明两者可以有效且优雅地结合，利用DP作为主搜索框架、CP作为子程序来利用全局约束传播，从而克服纯DP方法的局限性。
AI.method: 以DP作为主搜索框架，CP作为子程序利用全局约束传播；支持任意时间DP策略（如任意时间列搜索）；利用CP建模的灵活性纳入任意优先约束；设计了大邻域搜索（LNS）方案，复用DP模型并在重启间施加偏序调度以改进当前最优解。
AI.result: 在部分车间调度问题上验证了DP-CP混合集成的可行性；虽然与最先进的纯CP求解器相比不具有竞争力，但证明了这种混合方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DP与CP可以有效结合，DP作为主搜索框架、CP作为子程序利用全局约束传播是一种可行的混合集成方案，为后续研究提供了新的方向。
idea_en: A hybrid DP-CP method for combinatorial optimization where DP serves as primary search framework and CP filters infeasible states via global constraint propagation
An anytime column search strategy integrated with CP propagation for flexible anytime decision-making in scheduling problems
A Large Neighborhood Search (LNS) scheme that reuses DP model and imposes partial-order schedules across restarts to improve incumbent solution

title: Co-ReAct: Rubrics as Step-Level Collaborators for ReAct Agents
summary: ReAct-style agents for search-intensive, multi-step reasoning tasks rely largely on their own internal judgment to decide what evidence to seek, which reasoning or action step to take next, and when to stop, often producing shallow, redundant, or poorly targeted trajectories. Prior work has explored rubrics as external quality signals, but existing uses are mostly evaluative rather than action-guiding: rubrics typically serve as training-time rewards or post-hoc evaluators of completed outputs, and in deep-research settings they are often coarse-grained and report-level rather than step-level. We introduce Co-ReAct, a rubric-guided action-selection framework that uses rubrics as step-level guidance during inference. At each decision step, Co-ReAct injects a rubric into the agent's context to guide the next Reason-or-Act decision, specifying what the agent should target in evidence seeking, search, reasoning, or self-evaluation. To make this guidance reliable, we train a dedicated rubric generator with GRPO. Unlike prior pairwise or binary preference formulations, our objective optimizes a list-wise Spearman rank-correlation reward against multi-judge expert consensus rankings, encouraging rubrics that are discriminative rather than merely plausible. On DeepResearchBench and SQA-CS-V2, Co-ReAct consistently improves over ReAct and representative test-time compute baselines across search agents built on both 8B/14B open-source and frontier closed-source base models. The trained rubric generator can also serve as a drop-in component that improves these baselines without changing their underlying decision mechanisms. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZBWpro/Co-ReAct.

AI.tldr: Co-ReAct提出了一种基于评分准则(rubric)引导的推理-行动选择框架，在每一步推理中注入细粒度的步骤级准则来指导智能体在搜索密集型多步推理任务中的决策，并通过基于Spearman排序相关性的列表级奖励训练专用的准则生成器，显著优于ReAct等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的ReAct风格智能体在搜索密集型多步推理任务中，主要依赖自身内部判断来决定搜索什么证据、下一步采取什么行动以及何时停止，容易产生浅层、冗余或目标不明确的轨迹。虽然已有工作探索了将rubric作为外部质量信号，但大多仅用于训练阶段奖励或事后评估，缺乏步骤级的行动指导能力。
AI.method: 提出Co-ReAct框架：1) 在推理的每个决策步骤，将rubric注入智能体上下文，指导下一步是推理(Reason)还是行动(Act)，明确证据搜索、搜索、推理或自我评估的目标；2) 使用GRPO训练专用rubric生成器；3) 提出列表级Spearman排序相关奖励，替代传统的成对或二元偏好优化，鼓励生成具有区分度的rubric。
AI.result: 在DeepResearchBench和SQA-CS-V2基准上，Co-ReAct在8B/14B开源模型和前沿闭源基础模型上构建的搜索智能体中，一致优于ReAct和代表性的测试时计算基线。训练好的rubric生成器可作为即插即用组件，无需改变底层决策机制即可提升基线性能。
AI.conclusion: Co-ReAct验证了步骤级rubric引导在搜索密集型推理任务中的有效性，其列表级排序奖励训练策略显著提升了rubric的判别能力，且具有良好的通用性和可迁移性。

title: Solving the Aircraft Disassembly Scheduling Problem
summary: Dismantling aircrafts reaching their end of life is a complex endeavour that is necessary in terms of sustainability but yields small income margins for air transport companies. An efficient scheduling of the disassembly procedure is thus crucial to ensure the profitability of the process and incentivize practice. This is a large scheduling problem that involves thousands of tasks and many different constraints: Extracting parts that are destined to be reused requires technicians with specific certifications and equipment. Extraction operations might be subject to precedence relations. Furthermore, the aircraft must be kept balanced during the whole process. Finally, some of the locations of the aircraft have a limited space that caps the number of technicians able to work there concurrently. This article presents the problem in details and proposes two approaches to solve the problem: a Constraint Programming model and a MIP model. The models are tested on instances of varying sizes involving up to 1450 tasks, which are based on real operational data provided by an industrial partner.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了飞机报废拆解的高效调度问题，提出了约束规划（CP）和混合整数规划（MIP）两种模型，以应对数千项任务、技能认证、设备约束、先后顺序、机身平衡及空间限制等多重复杂约束，基于真实工业数据验证了模型的有效性。
AI.motivation: 飞机报废拆解是可持续发展必要的复杂过程，但利润空间很小，高效调度是确保盈利并激励行业实践的关键。
AI.method: 建立了包含任务排序、技术认证、设备约束、机身平衡、空间容量等约束的调度问题模型；分别采用约束规划（CP）和混合整数规划（MIP）两种方法求解。
AI.result: 基于工业合作伙伴提供的真实运营数据，测试了多达1450项任务的不同规模实例，验证了两种模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 约束规划和混合整数规划均可有效求解飞机拆解调度问题，为提升拆解流程盈利性和可持续性提供了可行的技术方案。
idea_en: A constraint programming model for aircraft disassembly scheduling that simultaneously handles technician certification constraints, equipment availability, precedence relations, aircraft balance maintenance, and workspace capacity limitations.
A MIP model formulation for end-of-life aircraft dismantling that optimizes task sequencing under multi-constraint conditions including spatial caps on concurrent technician work.
A balanced disassembly scheduling method that maintains aircraft structural balance throughout the entire extraction process while maximizing profitability of reused parts recovery.

title: One Policy, Infinite NPCs: Persona-Traceable Shared RL Policies for Scalable Game Agents
summary: On a 300-persona life-simulation benchmark, pcsp achieves compositional zero-shot persona identification up to 17x above chance, Spearman rho approx 0.73 semantic-behavioral alignment, and 22x faster inference than an LLM-as-policy baseline. Life simulation games require hundreds to thousands of non-player characters (NPCs) that behave consistently with distinct personalities while remaining controllable through designer-authored natural language. Existing methods fail on constraints like persona consistency, controllability, or real-time inference. We introduce pcsp (Persona Conditioned Shared Policy), a single reinforcement learning policy conditioned on frozen LLM embeddings of free-form persona descriptions. pcsp combines once-per-NPC persona encoding, low-rank persona projection, neural persona conditioning, and a PPO + InfoNCE consistency + KL diversity training objective. Across three experimental settings, ablations show that the InfoNCE trajectory-consistency objective is load bearing: removing it collapses zero-shot persona identification to chance. External validation on Melting Pot 2.4.0 substrates confirms that our method produces persona-conditioned behavioral divergence in multi-agent strategic environments. We distinguish two senses of held-out evaluation: compositional zero-shot and vocabulary-expansion held-out. Finally, a UE5 deployment reproduces the in-engine persona-conditioning ablation at 64 agents with a low failure rate, showing that the sub-frame inference profile survives in a commercial game engine. These results prove that shared RL policies can support scalable, real-time, persona-conditioned NPC control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCSP（人格条件共享策略），通过单一强化学习策略结合冻结的LLM人格嵌入，实现大规模NPC的零-shot人格识别、语义-行为对齐和实时推理，在300人生命模拟基准上达到17倍于随机的零-shot识别率，推理速度比LLM基线快22倍。
AI.motivation: 生命模拟游戏中需要数百到数千个NPC具有一致的人格行为，同时可通过设计者自然语言进行控制。现有方法在人格一致性、可控性或实时推理方面存在不足。
AI.method: PCSP方法包括：(1) 每个NPC一次性人格编码；(2) 低秩人格投影；(3) 神经人格条件化；(4) PPO + InfoNCE一致性 + KL多样性训练目标。利用冻结的LLM嵌入作为条件输入到单一强化学习策略中。
AI.result: 零-shot人格识别比随机高17倍，Spearman ρ≈0.73语义-行为对齐，推理速度比LLM基线快22倍。InfoNCE目标至关重要，移除后零-shot识别降至随机水平。在Melting Pot 2.4.0和UE5引擎中验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 证明了共享RL策略可以支持可扩展、实时、人格条件化的NPC控制，为游戏NPC的行为生成提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: MemAudit: Post-hoc Auditing of Poisoned Agent Memory via Causal Attribution and Structural Anomaly Detection
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on persistent memory to store past interactions, retrieve relevant demonstrations, and improve long-horizon task execution. However, this memory mechanism also creates a practical security vulnerability: an adversarial user may inject malicious records into the agent's memory through ordinary interaction, and these records can later be retrieved to steer the agent's reasoning and actions. Existing defenses primarily focus on online intervention, such as prompt filtering or output blocking, but they do not address the post-hoc question of which stored memories are responsible after harmful behavior has already been observed. We propose \textbf{MemAudit}, a post-hoc causal memory auditing framework for memory-augmented LLM agents. The framework combines two complementary signals: (1) a counterfactual memory influence score that measures each memory's causal contribution to harmful outputs, and (2) a memory consistency graph that identifies structurally anomalous memories within the broader memory store. We evaluate MemAudit against MINJA, a query-only memory injection attack in which malicious records are generated and stored through normal agent interactions rather than direct memory-bank modification. Across both QA and reasoning-agent settings, MemAudit substantially reduces attack success rates under realistic post-hoc auditing scenarios. The results show that QA attack success is reduced from $70\%$ to $0\%$, while RAP attack success drops from $83.3\%$ to $0\%$.

AI.tldr: MemAudit是一个针对记忆增强型LLM智能体的后验因果记忆审计框架，通过反事实记忆影响分数和记忆一致性图两个互补信号，有效检测和缓解记忆注入攻击，将QA攻击成功率从70%降至0%，RAP攻击成功率从83.3%降至0%。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖持久记忆存储历史交互以改进任务执行，但这种记忆机制存在安全漏洞：攻击者可通过正常交互向智能体记忆注入恶意记录，后续被检索时引导智能体产生有害行为。现有防御主要集中在在线干预（如提示过滤或输出阻止），但无法回答有害行为发生后哪些存储记忆应被问责的后验问题。
AI.method: MemAudit框架包含两个互补信号：(1) 反事实记忆影响分数，衡量每条记忆对有害输出的因果贡献；(2) 记忆一致性图，识别记忆存储中结构异常的记忆。通过结合这两种信号进行后验审计。
AI.result: 在QA和推理智能体两种设置下，MemAudit在现实后验审计场景中显著降低了攻击成功率。QA攻击成功率从70%降至0%，RAP攻击成功率从83.3%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: MemAudit是一种有效的后验因果记忆审计方法，能够精准识别导致有害行为的恶意记忆注入，为记忆增强型LLM智能体的安全提供了新的防御方向。

title: Agentic Proving for Program Verification
summary: Agentic systems have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for automated theorem proving in formal mathematics. To assess how far these capabilities extend to program verification, we evaluate Claude Code in an agentic proving framework on CLEVER, a Lean 4 benchmark for verifiable code generation. Our results show that Claude generates arguably valid specifications for 98.8% of problems (with 81.3% also accepted by CLEVER's isomorphism-based scoring on the correct portion of the benchmark), certifies implementations against correct ground-truth specifications for 87.5% of problems, and reaches a 98.1% success rate on the end-to-end program generation and verification pipeline over entries with self-consistent premises. Across all stages, Claude further provides high-quality feedback on its own attempts (as confirmed under manual review), identifying underlying causes of failure and lingering bugs in the dataset. These findings highlight a growing mismatch between the difficulty of existing program verification benchmarks and the capabilities of modern agentic provers, and point to the need for more rigorous, bug-resilient evaluation methodologies, and in particular for alternatives to isomorphism-based scoring of generated specifications. More broadly, our results provide empirical evidence that tight compiler-in-the-loop agentic paradigms are currently the most effective approach for foundational program verification.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了Claude Code在Lean 4基准测试CLEVER上的智能体证明能力，结果显示其在规范生成、实现验证和端到端程序生成方面表现出色，指出当前程序验证基准难度已落后于现代智能体证明器能力。
AI.motivation: 评估智能体系统在形式化数学中自动定理证明的最新进展是否能扩展到程序验证领域，以及现有基准测试是否仍能有效衡量现代智能体证明器的能力。
AI.method: 在CLEVER（Lean 4可验证代码生成基准）上使用Claude Code构建智能体证明框架，进行规范生成、实现验证和端到端程序生成与验证管道的多阶段评估。
AI.result: Claude对98.8%的问题生成可接受的规范，87.5%的问题通过正确规范认证实现，端到端管道成功率达98.1%，并能提供高质量的自反馈。
AI.conclusion: 现有程序验证基准的难度已不足以衡量现代智能体证明器的能力，需要更严格、对错误更具鲁棒性的评估方法；编译器在环的智能体范式是目前最有效的基础程序验证方法。

title: Beyond Binary Edits Robust Multimodal Knowledge Editing with Adversarial Subspace Alignment
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) need efficient mechanisms to update knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. While intrinsic multimodal knowledge editing achieves strong reliability and locality, it often exhibits limited generality, failing to propagate edits across semantically equivalent visual and linguistic variations. This issue arises from the lack of explicit semantic supervision, rigid editing scopes, and biased anchoring to individual samples in high-dimensional multimodal spaces. We address robust intrinsic multimodal knowledge editing by explicitly targeting generalization. We formalize robustness through knowledge units that group semantically equivalent multimodal inputs and define generality as consistent predictions within each unit. To expose fragile semantic regions, we introduce Latent Adversarial Robustification (LAR), which generates adversarial yet semantically coherent variants in the joint latent space. We further propose Rank-Constrained Subspace Learning (RCSL), enforcing low-rank alignment of adversarial representations at the edit layer via a singular value-based objective. Extensive analysis demonstrates the effectiveness of ASAM empirically.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ASAM的方法，通过潜在对抗鲁棒化（LAR）和秩约束子空间学习（RCSL）来增强多模态大语言模型中知识编辑的泛化能力，解决内在多模态知识编辑中语义等价变体预测不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的内在多模态知识编辑方法虽然可靠性和定位性良好，但泛化能力有限，无法在语义等价的视觉和语言变体间传播编辑结果。根本原因在于缺乏显式语义监督、编辑范围僵化以及在高维多模态空间中过度锚定单个样本。
AI.method: 1) 提出Latent Adversarial Robustification (LAR)：在联合潜在空间中生成对抗性但语义一致的变体，暴露脆弱的语义区域；2) 提出Rank-Constrained Subspace Learning (RCSL)：通过基于奇异值的优化目标，在编辑层强制实现对抗性表示的低秩对齐。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ASAM方法在内在多模态知识编辑的泛化鲁棒性上取得了显著效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式针对泛化性进行鲁棒内在多模态知识编辑，LAR和RCSL方法有效解决了传统方法在语义等价变体上预测不一致的问题。
